title: Water system development fee based on daily use
summary: On April 24, the chair recommended sending Bill 76, on the water system development fee, to a water committee. Earlier, on April 21, a committee approved cutting $500,000 from the wastewater operations B account and reducing bond funding for a wastewater pump station project by $500,000.
